title: SKP Orchestrator
description: Orchestrator control plane -- 3 replicas across 5 queues. The panel set mirrors SKP Processor and is generated from the same helpers, with pipeline.leader standing in for pipeline.identity.ready, plus two panels for pipeline.hydration.admitted, which exists on no other host.

list.name: role
list.label: Role
list.description: What this replica WAS when it handled the delivery, not a replica selector -- service_instance_id is that, and one replica carries both values across a leadership change. Reaches the five instruments carrying the ambient tag: messages.produced, messages.consumed, produce.duration, queue.wait and consumer.duration. The gauges and broker-side levels have no role label, so the filter is not applied to them -- a role matcher does not match a series that has no role label, and applying it board-wide would empty them. The Verdict tier is left unfiltered on purpose: it answers *is anything wrong anywhere*, and a role selection there would let a follower fault hide behind a leader view.

panels.title: Gate open
panels.description:
Measures `pipeline.gate.open`, minimum across replicas. 1 = the projection store is usable and consumers may run; 0 = the gate is shut and every delivery is being requeued.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Leader
panels.description: Measures how many replicas hold the lease. Must be exactly 1: 0 means nobody is firing schedules, 2 means a split.

panels.title: Hydration admitted
panels.description:
Measures `pipeline.hydration.admitted`, minimum across replicas. 1 once every replica's first hydration pass has finished and consumption was admitted.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Not acked
panels.description:
Measures `pipeline.messages.consumed` with disposition requeued or parked, over the last 5m. Split by `reason` on `Messages consumed by disposition`.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

targets.expr: (((sum by (service_instance_id)(increase(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",disposition=~"requeued|parked"}[5m]))) > (clamp_min((sum by (service_instance_id)(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",disposition=~"requeued|parked"})) - (sum by (service_instance_id)(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",disposition=~"requeued|parked"} offset 5m)), 0))) or (clamp_min((sum by (service_instance_id)(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",disposition=~"requeued|parked"})) - (sum by (service_instance_id)(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",disposition=~"requeued|parked"} offset 5m)), 0))) or (group by (service_instance_id) (last_over_time(pipeline_gate_open_ratio{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}[$__range])) * 0)

panels.title: Produce faults
panels.description:
Measures `pipeline.messages.produced` with outcome transient, unroutable or refused, over the last 5m.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

targets.expr: (((sum by (service_instance_id)(increase(pipeline_messages_produced_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",outcome=~"transient|unroutable|refused"}[5m]))) > (clamp_min((sum by (service_instance_id)(pipeline_messages_produced_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",outcome=~"transient|unroutable|refused"})) - (sum by (service_instance_id)(pipeline_messages_produced_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",outcome=~"transient|unroutable|refused"} offset 5m)), 0))) or (clamp_min((sum by (service_instance_id)(pipeline_messages_produced_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",outcome=~"transient|unroutable|refused"})) - (sum by (service_instance_id)(pipeline_messages_produced_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",outcome=~"transient|unroutable|refused"} offset 5m)), 0))) or (group by (service_instance_id) (last_over_time(pipeline_gate_open_ratio{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}[$__range])) * 0)

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

targets.expr: (((sum by (service_instance_id)(increase(pipeline_messages_produced_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",outcome=~"transient|unroutable|refused"}[$__range]))) > (clamp_min((sum by (service_instance_id)(pipeline_messages_produced_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",outcome=~"transient|unroutable|refused"})) - (sum by (service_instance_id)(pipeline_messages_produced_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",outcome=~"transient|unroutable|refused"} offset $__range)), 0))) or (clamp_min((sum by (service_instance_id)(pipeline_messages_produced_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",outcome=~"transient|unroutable|refused"})) - (sum by (service_instance_id)(pipeline_messages_produced_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",outcome=~"transient|unroutable|refused"} offset $__range)), 0))) or (group by (service_instance_id) (last_over_time(pipeline_gate_open_ratio{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}[$__range])) * 0)

panels.title: Dead-letter depth (all queues)
panels.description: Measures `pipeline.deadletter.depth`, summed across this service's dead-letter queues, right now.

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description:
Measures `changes(pipeline.process.start.timestamp)` across replicas over the visible range. The gauge holds the process start time and moves exactly once per process.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Messages consumed by disposition
panels.description:
Measures the rate of `pipeline.messages.consumed` by queue and disposition. Exactly one increment per delivery, on every exit path.

Legend: `{{queue}} {{disposition}} {{service_instance_id}}`

targets.expr: (sum by (queue,disposition,service_instance_id) (rate(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",role=~"$role"}[$__rate_interval]))) or (label_replace(group by (queue,service_instance_id) (last_over_time(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",role=~"$role"}[$__range])), "disposition", "acked", "", "") * 0) or (label_replace(group by (queue,service_instance_id) (last_over_time(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",role=~"$role"}[$__range])), "disposition", "requeued", "", "") * 0) or (label_replace(group by (queue,service_instance_id) (last_over_time(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",role=~"$role"}[$__range])), "disposition", "parked", "", "") * 0)

panels.title: Produced by type and outcome
panels.description:
Egress. outcome != accepted is a fault.

Legend: `{{type}} / {{outcome}} {{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Consumption balance
panels.description:
Measures the rate of acked `pipeline.messages.consumed` per replica. Replicas share one queue and the broker round-robins, so a replica near zero beside working peers is consuming nothing while still looking healthy.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Consumer duration by disposition
panels.description:
Measures `pipeline.consumer.duration` — how long a delivery was held, on every exit path including the ones that never reached a handler.

Legend: `mean {{queue}} {{disposition}} {{service_instance_id}}`

targets.expr: (sum by (queue,disposition,service_instance_id) (rate(pipeline_consumer_duration_seconds_sum{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (queue,disposition,service_instance_id) (rate(pipeline_consumer_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}[$__rate_interval]))) or (label_replace(group by (queue,service_instance_id) (last_over_time(pipeline_consumer_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}[$__range])), "disposition", "acked", "", "") * 0) or (label_replace(group by (queue,service_instance_id) (last_over_time(pipeline_consumer_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}[$__range])), "disposition", "requeued", "", "") * 0) or (label_replace(group by (queue,service_instance_id) (last_over_time(pipeline_consumer_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}[$__range])), "disposition", "parked", "", "") * 0)

panels.title: Produce duration
panels.description:
Measures `pipeline.produce.duration` by queue — from the start of a send until the broker confirmed or refused it, publisher confirm included. p95, p99 and mean.

Legend: `p95|p99|mean {{queue}} {{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Queue wait by queue
panels.description:
Measures `pipeline.queue.wait` — seconds between a message being published and a consumer picking it up, as a mean per queue and replica.

Legend: `raw|net {{queue}} {{service_instance_id}}`

targets.expr: avg by (queue,service_instance_id) (rate(pipeline_queue_wait_seconds_sum{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}[$__rate_interval]) / rate(pipeline_queue_wait_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}[$__rate_interval])) - on(queue) group_left avg by (queue) (label_replace(rate(pipeline_produce_duration_seconds_sum{destination=~"orchestrator-.*"}[$__rate_interval]) / rate(pipeline_produce_duration_seconds_count{destination=~"orchestrator-.*"}[$__rate_interval]), "queue", "$1", "destination", "(.*)"))

defaults.noValue: no deliveries carrying a send timestamp in range

panels.title: Queue depth by queue
panels.description:
Measures `pipeline.queue.depth` per queue — messages ready and not yet taken, from the broker's own passive declare.

Legend: `{{queue}} {{service_instance_id}}`

defaults.noValue: no queue depth reported -- nothing is probing these queues

panels.title: Consumers attached by queue
panels.description:
Measures `pipeline.queue.consumers` per queue — how many consumers THE BROKER has attached. 0 means nothing is listening.

Legend: `{{queue}} {{service_instance_id}}`

defaults.noValue: no consumer count reported -- nothing is probing these queues

panels.title: Dead-letter depth by queue
panels.description:
Measures `pipeline.deadletter.depth` per queue — refused messages nobody has dealt with yet.

Legend: `{{queue}} {{service_instance_id}}`

defaults.noValue: no dead-letter depth reported by this service -- see the panel description before reading this as zero

panels.title: Gate open and trips by replica
panels.description:
Measures `pipeline.gate.open` per replica, with `increase(pipeline.gate.trips)` over the range beside it.

Legend: `gate|trips {{service_instance_id}}`

defaults.noValue: no gate reporting -- this replica is not exporting at all

panels.title: Gate probe outcomes
panels.description:
Measures the RATE of `pipeline.gate.probe.duration` observations, split by outcome — healthy, timeout or failed.

Legend: `{{outcome}} {{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Gate probe duration
panels.description:
Measures `pipeline.gate.probe.duration` — how long the projection store took to answer the gate probe. p95, p99 and mean.

Legend: `p95|p99|mean {{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Loop iterations by loop
panels.description:
Measures the rate of `pipeline.loop.iterations` by loop. Measured on this host: l2-gate 0.2/s, queue-depth 0.1/s, orchestrator-l1-reap 0.003/s (a 5-minute period).

Legend: `{{loop}} {{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Leader by replica
panels.description:
Measures `pipeline.leader` per replica — which one holds the lease, and when it changed hands.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Hydration admitted by replica
panels.description:
Measures `pipeline.hydration.admitted` per replica. One-shot: a row turns green once and stays there for the life of the process.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Exception rate
panels.description:
Correlates with rising parked / refused dispositions and with faulted process outcomes. On the visible tier because a rising exception rate is a cause an operator should not have to expand a row to find.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Thread-pool queue length
panels.description:
Explains consumption stalling while the gate is open and the consumer still reports consuming=1: callbacks are starved, not blocked.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Thread-pool threads
panels.description:
Measures `process_runtime_dotnet_thread_pool_threads_count` per replica.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: GC pause time
panels.description:
Seconds of GC pause per second. Explains duration p99 spikes with no broker or dependency fault.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: GC collections / sec by generation
panels.description:
**The cause behind the pause time to its left.** Pause seconds answer *how much*, this answers *why*: gen0 is cheap and constant, and a gen2 rate that is anything but near-flat is the collection that actually costs you.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}} / {{generation}}`

panels.title: GC heap size by generation
panels.description:
Managed heap, by generation. **The leak signal**: a gen2 or LOH line that steps up and never comes back down across several collections is retention, and it ends in an OOMKill that every pipeline panel will report as a restart with no cause.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}} / {{generation}}`

panels.title: GC committed memory
panels.description:
What the GC has committed from the OS -- **the number the container limit is compared against**, not the managed heap beside it. The two diverge, and the gap is why a pod can be OOMKilled while its heap looks healthy: committed memory is returned to the OS lazily, so it tracks the high-water mark rather than the live set.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Allocation rate
panels.description:
Bytes allocated per second -- **upstream of every other panel in this row.** Collections, pause time and committed memory are all consequences of this number; it is the one that moves first when a transform starts allocating per message.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Lock contention rate
panels.description:
Monitor contentions per second: threads that had to WAIT for a lock rather than take it. **The stall with no external cause** -- gate open, broker healthy, store fast, and throughput down anyway.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`
